claims.text: At stage-1 ProductTile shows Text('${product.priceVnd} đ') and its Semantics label is '${product.name}, ${product.priceVnd} đồng'; product 'Bàn phím cơ' costs 1250000.

At stage-2 app_en.arb has "productPrice": "{price} VND" and "productSemanticsLabel": "{name}, {price} dong"; app_vi.arb has "{price} đ" and "{name}, {price} đồng" for the same keys, with no @ entries.

In an ARB message, a name in braces such as {price} is a placeholder; the template's @<key> entry declares each placeholder under "placeholders" with a "type" (e.g. int, String) and optionally a "format".
claims.source_hint: Flutter docs: Internationalizing Flutter apps (Placeholders, plurals, and selects; Messages with numbers and currencies)

claims.text: For a message with placeholders gen-l10n generates a method taking the typed values instead of a getter: String productPrice(int price) and String productSemanticsLabel(String name, int price).
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang @ stage-2: DonHang.App/lib/l10n/app_localizations.dart (generated); Flutter docs: Internationalizing Flutter apps (Placeholders)

claims.text: Calling productPrice with a String instead of an int is a compile error (argument_type_not_assignable), because the generated parameter is typed int.
claims.source_hint: Dart language: static type checking of arguments; generated signature productPrice(int price) @ stage-2

claims.text: An int placeholder with format decimalPattern is formatted by the generated code with intl NumberFormat.decimalPattern(localeName): 1250000 becomes 1,250,000 for en and 1.250.000 for vi.
claims.source_hint: generated app_localizations_en.dart / _vi.dart @ stage-2; intl 0.20 NumberFormat.decimalPattern; probe on stage-2 archive: en '1,250,000 VND', vi '1.250.000 đ'

claims.text: Joining translated fragments with + fixes the word order in code for every language and hands translators fragments without their sentence; one message per whole sentence avoids both.
claims.source_hint: outline item 2; Flutter docs: Internationalizing Flutter apps (placeholders let each translation place the value)
